decisions.reason: Reusing Harbor Valley content and images in the Ridgehaven mockup does not change the requirement to keep the legacy site live or route visitors to it during transition.
The accepted reuse is for a Ridgehaven preview and does not alter the existing Harbor Valley SEO-preservation or migration-handling requirements.
The proposal retains the already established new logo and branding; accepting content and image reuse does not modify any brand-identity attribute.
The competitor-based layout and structure are restated without change, while the newly accepted decision concerns reuse of existing content and images for the mockup.
Mockup content and image reuse does not affect separate location analytics, reporting, revenue, or sales tracking.
The decision does not change the master site's location selector, selectable locations, or routing behavior.
Reusing content and images for a Ridgehaven mockup does not change booking placement, isolation, or activation behavior.
The accepted mockup reuse has no effect on separate Wix payment setups or payout isolation.
Content and image reuse does not alter the requirement for Ridgehaven to maintain a separate customer database.
The mockup-content decision does not change Ridgehaven's separate gift-card operations.
The accepted reuse of content and images does not affect location membership isolation.
The source decision does not introduce or change any domain-to-website mapping.
